description: Pixpilot workspace package generator template for pnpm + Turbo monorepo. Provides project info prompts and config tasks.
name: github-pixpilot-owner-changesets-release

prompts.message: Publish packages privately to GitHub Packages under @pixpilot-private? (No = npmjs)

tasks.name: Setup Changesets Release Workflow
tasks.description: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow for Changesets-based releases

tasks.name: Setup Changesets Release Workflow (GitHub Packages)
tasks.description: Adds a Changesets release workflow publishing to GitHub Packages under @pixpilot-private instead of npmjs

tasks.name: Declare registry token in CI workflow
tasks.description: release-github-packages.yml passes PIXPILOT_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_TOKEN to ci.yml; GitHub rejects release.yml unless ci.yml declares it under workflow_call

config.replacement:
workflow_call:
    # Declared so release.yml can pass it; called workflows get no secrets otherwise.
    secrets:
      PIXPILOT_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_TOKEN:
        required: false

tasks.name: Use registry token in CI install
tasks.description: Lets the CI install authenticate to GitHub Packages for @pixpilot-private dependencies

config.replacement:
uses: pixpilot/github-actions/setup-pnpm-project@v1
        env:
          # Read by setup-node's .npmrc to install @pixpilot-private dependencies.
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PIXPILOT_PRIVATE_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        with:
          registry-url: 'https://npm.pkg.github.com'
          # Only route @pixpilot-private to GitHub Packages; @pixpilot stays on npmjs.
          scope: '@pixpilot-private'

tasks.name: Cleanup Changesets Release Workflow
tasks.description: Removes Pixpilot owner condition from Changesets release workflow
